text: ICE-JAM WARNING: river still frozen near Kashechewan, Fort Albany (Kashechewan 99%; Fort Albany 97% frozen) while only 11% frozen upstream, so water arriving from upstream may back up. Radar shows 66.6 km² of water beyond normal river extent. Closest lifeline: Fort Albany causeway, 63 m from flood-day water (red). Radar dates: normal 2025-08-07, flood 2025-04-30.
